title: 硝化與反硝化分區控制~Zonal nitrification and denitrification control
focus: 分區供氧、回流與碳鹼度協調~Coordinating zonal aeration, recycle, carbon and alkalinity
summary: 本課以分區供氧、回流與碳鹼度協調為主線，從氮物種與負荷基準、硝化理論需氧、硝化鹼度消耗、反硝化電子供體進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops coordinating zonal aeration, recycle, carbon and alkalinity through ten connected units, beginning with species and nitrogen basis, nitrification oxygen balance, alkalinity demand, denitrification donor demand. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 氮物種與負荷基準~Species and nitrogen basis
units.mechanism: 先把氨氮、亞硝酸氮與硝酸氮統一以 N 計，建立各區需求。~Put ammonium, nitrite and nitrate on an N basis before allocating zones.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=1200 m³/d；NH4-N=40 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：所有氮濃度以 N 質量計；不可混用 NH4 的分子質量。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=1200 m³/d; NH4-N=40 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: All concentrations are on an N-mass basis, not NH4 molecular mass.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「氮物種與負荷基準」的觀測點。校正流量與氨氮儀，保留採樣時段。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for species and nitrogen basis. Calibrate flow and ammonium instruments and retain the sampling interval. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 分子量與氮質量混用造成倍數誤差。診斷與介入：把各流股氮物種分列，查核高氨回流是否漏算。~Mixing molecular and N mass creates multiplicative errors. Diagnostic response: Separate nitrogen species for every stream and check for omitted ammonium-rich returns.
units.misconception: mg NH4/L 可直接當成 mg N/L。~mg NH4/L equals mg N/L.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:1200→1500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 48 變為 60 kg N/d。用「氮物種與負荷基準」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:1200→1500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 48 to 60 kg N/d. Explain the direction using species and nitrogen basis, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 硝化理論需氧~Nitrification oxygen balance
units.mechanism: 硝化需氧與有機物耗氧同時存在，供氧表應分項而非重複計算。~Nitrification and carbonaceous demands coexist; tabulate them separately without double-counting.
units.model: 原創教學假設：硝化 NH4-N=40 kg/d；理論 O2/N=4.57。模型 O2=4.57×N，代入得到 182.8 kg O2/d。適用邊界：完全氧化至硝酸鹽的理論需氧；異營與內源耗氧另外列。~Original teaching assumptions: Nitrified NH4-N=40 kg/d; theoretical O2/N=4.57. Model O2=4.57×N gives 182.8 kg O2/d. Applicability: Theoretical complete nitrification demand; heterotrophic and endogenous oxygen demand are separate.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「硝化理論需氧」的觀測點。把氨氮轉化量與耗氧率作質量配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrification oxygen balance. Pair ammonium conversion with oxygen-uptake measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 忽略異營耗氧使氧量不足。診斷與介入：分列有機與硝化需氧，用氮轉化量交叉核對。~Ignoring heterotrophic demand understates oxygen needs. Diagnostic response: Separate carbonaceous/nitrification demand and cross-check N conversion.
units.misconception: 硝化理論需氧就是全槽總耗氧。~Theoretical nitrification demand equals total tank demand.
units.practice: 只改變 N:40→50 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 182.8 變為 228.5 kg O2/d。用「硝化理論需氧」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:40→50 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 182.8 to 228.5 kg O2/d. Explain the direction using nitrification oxygen balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 硝化鹼度消耗~Alkalinity demand
units.mechanism: 氨氧化釋放酸度，剩餘緩衝能力會影響 pH 與菌群活性。~Ammonium oxidation consumes buffering capacity, influencing pH and activity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：硝化 NH4-N=40 kg/d；鹼度耗量=7.14 kg CaCO3/kg N。模型 A=7.14×N，代入得到 285.6 kg CaCO3/d。適用邊界：化學計量概估，緩衝、進流水鹼度與其他反應仍須納入。~Original teaching assumptions: Nitrified NH4-N=40 kg/d; alkalinity demand=7.14 kg CaCO3/kg N. Model A=7.14×N gives 285.6 kg CaCO3/d. Applicability: Stoichiometric estimate; buffering, influent alkalinity and other reactions remain necessary.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「硝化鹼度消耗」的觀測點。以滴定鹼度與氮物種變化交叉檢核。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for alkalinity demand. Cross-check titrated alkalinity against changing nitrogen species. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只量 pH 而不量鹼度可能錯過緩衝耗竭。診斷與介入：以鹼度滴定及氮轉化量查緩衝收支，不只調整 pH 顯示值。~pH alone can miss depletion of buffering capacity. Diagnostic response: Check buffering with alkalinity titration and N conversion, not just displayed pH.
units.misconception: pH 暫時正常就代表鹼度充足。~A normal instantaneous pH proves sufficient alkalinity.
units.practice: 只改變 N:40→45 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 285.6 變為 321.3 kg CaCO3/d。用「硝化鹼度消耗」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:40→45 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 285.6 to 321.3 kg CaCO3/d. Explain the direction using alkalinity demand, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 反硝化電子供體~Denitrification donor demand
units.mechanism: 缺氧區以硝酸鹽為電子受體，外加或內生碳需按可利用比例計算。~The anoxic zone uses nitrate as acceptor; external/internal carbon needs a bioavailability basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：NO3-N 去除量=30 kg/d；電子當量=2.86 kg COD/kg N。模型 CODmin=2.86×N，代入得到 85.8 kg COD/d。適用邊界：僅硝酸鹽還原的理論電子當量；不含菌體合成、溶氧與其他耗碳。~Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「反硝化電子供體」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for denitrification donor demand. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 不可降解 COD 被誤算為可用碳源。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。~Refractory COD is mistakenly counted as available donor. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
units.misconception: 所有 COD 都可立即反硝化。~All COD is immediately usable for denitrification.
units.practice: 只改變 N:30→36 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 85.8 變為 102.96 kg COD/d。用「反硝化電子供體」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:30→36 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 85.8 to 102.96 kg COD/d. Explain the direction using denitrification donor demand, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 鹼度回復~Alkalinity recovery
units.mechanism: 反硝化可部分補回硝化消耗的鹼度，但回復量依實際轉化量而定。~Denitrification can partly offset nitrification alkalinity demand according to actual conversion.
units.model: 原創教學假設：反硝化 NO3-N=30 kg/d；回復=3.57 kg CaCO3/kg N。模型 Arec=3.57×N，代入得到 107.1 kg CaCO3/d。適用邊界：只作反硝化鹼度回收的理論收支，不代表所有硝化耗量均回收。~Original teaching assumptions: Denitrified NO3-N=30 kg/d; recovery=3.57 kg CaCO3/kg N. Model Arec=3.57×N gives 107.1 kg CaCO3/d. Applicability: Theoretical denitrification recovery, not a claim that all nitrification demand is recovered.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「鹼度回復」的觀測點。在相同採樣日把硝化耗量、反硝化回復與實測鹼度並列。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for alkalinity recovery. Tabulate nitrification demand, denitrification recovery and measured alkalinity for the same day. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把理論全回復寫入收支掩蓋未完全反硝化。診斷與介入：將實際反硝化量和鹼度回復配對，保留進流緩衝項。~Assuming full recovery masks incomplete denitrification. Diagnostic response: Pair actual denitrification with recovered alkalinity and retain influent buffering.
units.misconception: 只要設缺氧槽就回復全部鹼度。~An anoxic tank restores all alkalinity.
units.practice: 只改變 N:30→35 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 107.1 變為 124.95 kg CaCO3/d。用「鹼度回復」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:30→35 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 107.1 to 124.95 kg CaCO3/d. Explain the direction using alkalinity recovery, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 內回流與攜氧~Internal recycle and oxygen carryover
units.mechanism: 增加回流帶回硝酸鹽也帶回氧，可能先耗掉缺氧區碳源。~More recycle returns nitrate but also oxygen, potentially consuming anoxic carbon first.
units.model: 原創教學假設：回流 Qr=6000 m³/d；進流 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 R=Qr/Q，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：回流提高物質交換也帶回溶氧；比值不是脫氮率。~Original teaching assumptions: Recycle Qr=6000 m³/d; influent Q=3000 m³/d. Model R=Qr/Q gives 2 ratio. Applicability: Recycle improves exchange but also carries oxygen; the ratio is not nitrogen-removal efficiency.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「內回流與攜氧」的觀測點。量回流支線流量、DO 與 NO3-N，避免只讀泵轉速。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for internal recycle and oxygen carryover. Measure recycle flow, DO and nitrate instead of using pump speed alone. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看回流比，未追蹤回流 DO。診斷與介入：量支線流量及 DO，離線比較回流與攜氧折衷。~Watching recycle ratio without recycle DO misses the penalty. Diagnostic response: Measure branch flow/DO and compare recycle/oxygen-carryover trade-offs offline.
units.misconception: 內回流越大脫氮一定越好。~More internal recycle always improves nitrogen removal.
units.practice: 只改變 Qr:6000→7500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2 變為 2.5 ratio。用「內回流與攜氧」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qr:6000→7500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2 to 2.5 ratio. Explain the direction using internal recycle and oxygen carryover, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 溶氧儀校正~DO-probe calibration
units.mechanism: 分區控制依賴可信感測值，偏移會把正常程序推到錯誤方向。~Zonal control needs credible measurements; sensor bias drives the process in the wrong direction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：參考濃度 x1=0、x2=8 mg/L；儀器讀值 y1=0.2、y2=7.8。模型 slope=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1)，代入得到 0.95 ratio。適用邊界：二點線性校正不能驗證全量程非線性；另留獨立檢查點。~Original teaching assumptions: Reference x1=0, x2=8 mg/L; readings y1=0.2, y2=7.8. Model slope=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1) gives 0.95 ratio. Applicability: Two-point calibration does not validate full-range nonlinearity; reserve an independent check point.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「溶氧儀校正」的觀測點。用第三個參考點比較校正殘差與容許誤差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for do-probe calibration. Compare a third reference point with calibration residual and required tolerance. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 探頭污染被誤認為真實氧需求改變。診斷與介入：清潔並依方法校正感測器，以獨立檢查點驗證。~Probe fouling is mistaken for changing oxygen demand. Diagnostic response: Clean/calibrate by the relevant method and verify using an independent point.
units.misconception: 自動控制可免除感測器校正。~Automation removes the need for sensor calibration.
units.practice: 只改變 y2:7.8→8.2 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.95 變為 1 ratio。用「溶氧儀校正」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only y2:7.8→8.2 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.95 to 1 ratio. Explain the direction using do-probe calibration, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 回流水混合~Recycle blending
units.mechanism: 高濃度側流水須用質量加權混合，不能平均兩個濃度數字。~Blend concentrated sidestreams by mass weighting, not an arithmetic concentration mean.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q1=1000、Q2=500 m³/d；C1=20、C2=80 mg/L。模型 Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)，代入得到 40 mg/L。適用邊界：無反應、同一成分與相同濃度基準；不可直接套用 pH。~Original teaching assumptions: Q1=1000, Q2=500 m³/d; C1=20, C2=80 mg/L. Model Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2) gives 40 mg/L. Applicability: No reaction and the same species/concentration basis; do not directly average pH this way.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「回流水混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recycle blending. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 低流量高氨流股可能控制負荷尖峰。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。~A small high-ammonium stream can dominate peak loading. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
units.misconception: 兩股水的濃度取算術平均即可。~Average the two concentrations arithmetically.
units.practice: 只改變 Q2:500→750 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40 變為 45.714286 mg/L。用「回流水混合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q2:500→750 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40 to 45.714286 mg/L. Explain the direction using recycle blending, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 分區有效接觸~Effective zonal contact
units.mechanism: 分隔牆與攪拌影響接觸分布，名義缺氧容積需用示蹤檢查。~Baffles and mixing affect contact distribution; verify nominal anoxic volume with tracing.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=150 m³；Q=3600 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 1 h。適用邊界：局部槽體的名義時間，不是生物反應完成時間。~Original teaching assumptions: V=150 m³; Q=3600 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 1 h. Applicability: Nominal time in one compartment, not a guarantee of biological completion.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「分區有效接觸」的觀測點。把分區入口與出口示蹤時間畫成圖。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective zonal contact. Plot tracer arrival at the compartment inlet and outlet. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 死角占據空間卻不提供相同比反應機會。診斷與介入：查分隔牆與旁流，將有效容積重新列入區段模型。~Dead zones occupy space without equivalent reaction opportunity. Diagnostic response: Check baffles and bypass streams and update the compartment effective volume.
units.misconception: 分區容積愈大必定按比例增效。~A larger zone always improves treatment proportionally.
units.practice: 只改變 V:150→180 m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 1.2 h。用「分區有效接觸」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only V:150→180 m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 1.2 h. Explain the direction using effective zonal contact, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 季節情境與交接~Seasonal scenarios and handoff
units.mechanism: 以低溫及峰值負荷重播控制策略，記錄溶氧、氨氮與能耗共同結果。~Replay low-temperature and peak-loading scenarios and record DO, ammonium and energy together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：r20=0.08 d⁻¹；θ=1.07；T=15 °C。模型 rT=r20 θ^(T-20)，代入得到 0.057038894 d⁻¹。適用邊界：假設係數且限狹窄溫度區間，不能跨菌群或熱失活區外插。~Original teaching assumptions: r20=0.08 d⁻¹; θ=1.07; T=15 °C. Model rT=r20 θ^(T-20) gives 0.057038894 d⁻¹. Applicability: Assumed coefficient in a narrow temperature range; do not extrapolate across populations or thermal inactivation.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「季節情境與交接」的觀測點。由不同溫度的批次資料擬合後，以未參與擬合的資料檢驗。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for seasonal scenarios and handoff. Fit batch data across temperatures and validate on held-out observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 夏季調校直接複製到冬季可能失敗。診斷與介入：改用符合溫度區間的實驗資料，重跑低溫情境。~Copying summer tuning to winter can fail. Diagnostic response: Use observations appropriate to the temperature range and replay cold conditions.
units.misconception: 同一控制參數全年都最佳。~One controller tuning is optimal year-round.
units.practice: 只改變 T:15→18 °C，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.057038894 變為 0.069875098 d⁻¹。用「季節情境與交接」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T:15→18 °C, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.057038894 to 0.069875098 d⁻¹. Explain the direction using seasonal scenarios and handoff, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
